title: Add P11.7 merged branch cleanup requirement
goal: Require an auditable cleanup of every Plan 06 child branch whose work is proven merged into codex/guards-principles-plan, without deleting or claiming completion in this change.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan 06 adds P11.7 after P11.6 and scopes it to local and remote child branches created during Plan 06 whose work is proven absorbed by codex/guards-principles-plan.
P11.7 requires an exact deletion inventory and merge proof for every deleted branch.
The base branch, current work branch, unmerged branches, branches with open pull requests, and branches without conclusive merge proof are explicitly preserved.
The CP12 ledger remains in progress and identifies P11.5 through P11.7 as pending; this change deletes no branch and leaves P11.7 unchecked.
